title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2608.11705v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation from the no-trait baseline, while Trait-Induced Flip Rate measures whether the same request receives different safety decisions across traits. We then provide a representation-level analysis of the mechanism behind trait-induced safety shifts and find that traits perturb the model's safety representations within a low-dimensional subspace. To achieve trait-invariant safety, where safety behavior remains stable across traits, we introduce Trait-Inva

translated_title: 让你的大语言模型更客观：通过特质不变安全调优稳定跨特质的大语言模型安全行为
translated_abstract: 对齐的大语言模型（LLMs）预期根据用户请求的内容表现出安全行为：它们应拒绝不安全请求并遵守安全请求。然而，我们表明，在系统提示中分配不同特质时，同一请求可能引发显著不同的安全决策，我们将这种失败模式称为特质诱导的安全变异。为衡量此失败，我们引入了基于拒绝的指标：特质诱导偏差衡量相对于无特质基线的数据集级偏差，而特质诱导翻转率衡量同一请求在不同特质下是否收到不同的安全决策。随后，我们提供了特质诱导安全转变机制的表征级分析，并发现特质在低维子空间内扰动模型的安全表征。为实现跨特质稳定的特质不变安全行为，我们引入了特质不变安全调优。
tldr: 本文提出了一种特质不变安全调优方法，通过识别和稳定低维子空间中的安全表征扰动，以消除大语言模型在不同系统提示特质下的安全行为变异。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces trait-invariant safety tuning to stabilize LLM safety behavior across system-prompt traits by mitigating low-dimensional subspace perturbations in safety representations.
